title: Payment Arrangements Terms Schedule — Installment Counts, Frequencies and Due-Date Limits
content:
For every type of Payment Arrangements this schedule fixes the largest number of installments, which payment frequencies may be chosen, the largest number of installments on each frequency, how many calendar days after the plan is created the first and the final installment must fall due, and the latest day of the month a monthly due date may fall on. The installment count always includes any down payment.

## Counts and frequencies

| Arrangement type | Largest installment count | Weekly offered | Largest weekly count | Biweekly offered | Largest biweekly count | Largest monthly count |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 2 | Yes | 2 | Yes | 2 | 2 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 6 | Yes | 12 | Yes | 12 | 6 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 12 | No | 0 | Yes | 26 | 12 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 24 | No | 0 | Yes | 52 | 24 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 48 | No | 0 | No | 0 | 48 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 60 | No | 0 | No | 0 | 60 |

A count of 0 on a frequency marks a frequency the type does not offer. Weekly schedules exist only on the Promise-to-Pay Arrangement and the Short-Term Installment Plan; the Long-Term Installment Plan and the Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan are monthly only.

## Due-date limits (calendar days after the plan is created)

| Arrangement type | First installment due within | Final installment due within | Latest monthly due day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 14 | 45 | 28 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 30 | 190 | 28 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 30 | 370 | 28 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 30 | 735 | 28 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 30 | 1465 | 28 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 45 | 1830 | 28 |

## Notes on the figures

- The largest installment count and the largest count for the chosen frequency are separate ceilings; a schedule respects both. On the Short-Term Installment Plan, for instance, the weekly ceiling reads 12 while the overall ceiling reads 6.
- The latest monthly due day is 28 on every type, so no monthly due date falls on the 29th, 30th or 31st.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Standard Installment Plan created on a given day must have its first regular installment due within 30 calendar days and its final installment due within 370 calendar days of that day.
